content: Yeesu hultiɗ
Ŋ mbehi taamb ŋ wi na iɗsiɗkohse na ɓaaɓa teel, ɓitiɓ ca ɓayya cuuraay ca ɓa haɓɗee, ɓa kaɗta ruy-ruyaŋ Yeesu.
Wa ɓa ree, ɓa raak atoh fa yakka rangee wa pilnginuuɗ.
Ɓa aassa, waaye ɓa hotɗi fiɗaafaŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu nga.
Ɓa inahɗi ini ɓa haɓɗan, weɗi ɓo' kanak teeɓkoh ɓa, ɓekkiɗ kulɓa na melciɗe melciɗ.
Ɓa tiitta, ɓa hiirra kip. Ƴaaɓa woosa ɓa ne : « Wa ye tah ɗu markee ɓoyi na pese ŋ kaaniɗ ci ?
A nikɗi ndii, a hultiɗuuɗ ! Naandsukaat ina a woyee ɗu, wa a nik na ɗu ŋ Galile.
A woyee ne : “ Kuɓkiŋ ɓoyi joyiɗ eɗu bakaaɗoh ci, ɓa daaƴ ɗe ŋ kurwaa, ŋ neeha kaahayɗoh a hulit. ” »
Ɓa naandsukka woo caŋ Yeesu.
Wa ɓitiɓ ca puloh ruy-ruya, ɓa kaɗta naandsuka in ceem jen Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci (11) na ɓa tas jen.
Mari Makdala na Saan na Mari yaay ɓi Saak na ɓi ɓitiɓ wiiriis, ɓeɗ woo Apootar ci wa.
Waaye ɓeem kosɗi ɓa, ɓa liiɓpa haa ne ɓa na woye mbalay.
Waaye Piyeer kurukka, a yurahha ŋ ruy-ruya na mbup. Wi a ree, a huusukka, a hotɗi ali in nga ɗal uufa ; a haadda, a liiɓsiɗoheeɗa ŋ ini raak.
Ŋ waas Emayuus
Mbaɗi taalube kanak nga ɓa, kaɗeeɗa kur ka na woyse Emayuus, harmban wa na Yerusalem joyiɗ ree tiindu wahtu kanak.
Ŋ waasa, ɓa ɓeesɗoheeɗa ŋ in ca raakee jen.
Weɗi Yeesu ŋ haf ce reɓoh ɓa, a hunnda na ɓa,
waaye in tahha po ɓa minɗi ɗe inhis.
A meekissa ɓa ne : « Ɗu na ɓeesɗohe ye an ŋ waasi ? » Ɓa tufukka, ɓa soossa.
Ƴaara teeksee Kelewopaas nga ɓa woosa ɗe ne : « Moo, hanaa ya fu dong nik ŋ Yerusalem inhaaɗi ini raak nga neeh cii ? »
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne « Wa ye raak ? » Ɓa loffa ɗe ne « Ini rahas Yeesu yi gen Nasareet. Ŋ fiki Kooh na fiki Israayel ci jen a nikee woosuuɗ yakak ŋ in ci a haɓɗee na woo ciŋ ɗe.
Waaye kilifaaciŋ seeƴkiɗoh ciŋ ɓoo na ɓi adgoh ɓoo ɓi Yawuut ci eɗohha ɗe ne a apu, ɓa daaƴɗukka ɗe ŋ kurwaa.
Ɓoo ambeen ne a yi na hee mucɗe Israayel, waaye ina wa raakoh poyi wa tumiɗ neeh kaahay.
Ɓi ɓitiɓ nga ɓoo deey, feyiɗ ɓoo woti ; ɓa ɓaaɓ-teelkiɗ ruy-ruyaŋ ɗe,
waaye ɓa raakɗi fiɗaafiŋ ɗe nga. Wa ɓa hay, ɓa woo ne ɓi malaaka teeɓkiɗ ɓa nga, ɓa woosa ɓa ne a yii pes.
Ɓi ɓo' nga ɓoo namiɗ kaɗ ruy-ruya, ɓa hotta ini ɓitiɓ ceem woo, waaye a yi ŋ haf ce, ɓa hotɗi ɗe. »
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne : « E ɗu ñaañaaɗi, te keeñ ciŋ ɗu gaawɗi kos in ci woosuuɗ ci woo jen.
Andi Mucɗohi Gapohse joyeeɗi yaaɓoh ɗaa ne a han aas ŋ ndamiŋ ɗe ? »
A teeɓpa ɓa in ci Fiis ci woo nga ɗe jen, cambohha ŋ teereeciŋ Musaa po ŋ ciŋ woosuuɗ ci jen.
Wa ɓa hee ree kur ka ɓa kaɗohe, a mannda na ɓoyi na taalndiɗe ;
waaye ɓa ammba ɗe, ɓa woosa ɗe ne « Wela fu tas na ɓoo, nohi weɗi muy, Kooh hooɓiɗ. » A aassa, a tassa na ɓa.
Wa ɓa hee ñame, a ɓayya mbuurnda, a corkiɗta Kooh, a nguɗsohhaa, a eɗeeɗa ɓa wa.
Teemb ndeem ina tahee po ɓa mineeɗi ɗe inhis, nihsukka, ɓa hotta ne a yi, waaye a saayya ŋ fikiiɓa.
Yaa nu nga ɗah, woosa morom ce ne : « Ŋ waasi, wi a teeɓee ɓoo ini Fiis ci woo, fu yegɗi in ŋ keeñiŋ ɗa e ? »
Ɓa jaarra kuruk, ɓa dokukka Yerusalem, ɓa raakka Apootar ci ndaŋkiyaah na yinooci (11) na ɓooɓa nikee na ɓa cohiɗ,
woyeeɗa ne : « Wa keeh ne Yeesu kilifaani hultiɗuuɗ ! A teeɓiɗ haf ce Simong ! »
Ƴaaɓa kanak ca nammba naandsuk ina rahas ɓa ŋ waasa, na findi ɓa inhisoh Yeesu wa a nguɗsohee mbuurnda.
Yeesu teeɓiɗ taalubeeciŋ ɗe a yi pes
Wa ɓa jombee ŋ ineem, ɗekka po a yi Yeesu, a nikka ŋ leerooɓa, a woosa ɓa ne : « Nikaat ŋ jam. »
Ɓa feyuusa lool, ɓa liiɓee ne a husiɗ.
Yeesu woosa ɓa ne « Wa ye fey ɗu po ɗu liiɓsiɗohee ŋ ineem ?
Markaat yaah ciŋ ngo na kot ciŋ ngo, a ñam. Laalaat to ɗu marak ! Husiɗ na raake faan na ƴoh findiiso e ? »
Wa a woo ɓa ineem, a teeɓpa ɓa yaah ciŋ ɗe na kot ciŋ ɗe.
Ɓa sumeen te ɓa feyseen weɗ tah ɓa areeɗi min kos. A meekissa ɓa andi ɓa raakiɗ kañam ndaam.
Ɓa eɗta ɗe nguɗ cuurund utuuɗ.
A ɓayyaa, a ñammbaa ŋ fikiiɓa.
Ƴutta, a woosa ɓa ne : « Naandsukaat ini ŋ woyee ɗu wa ŋ nikoh na ɗu ne : “ In ci woyu nga so ŋ waasiŋ Musaa na teereeciŋ woosuuɗ ci, na Sabuur joyiɗ raak jen. ” »
A rangissa liiɓohaaciŋ ɓa ne ɓa min inah ini Fiis ci tokis.
A woosa ɓa ne : « Inii weɗ Fiis ci woo : “ Mucɗohi Kooh gapoh hey yaaɓɗasse, a hey apse, a hulit ŋ mbeha kaahayɗoh.
Te ŋ cuuɓ ciŋ adinaani jen, te wa cambohsan Yerusalem, ɓooɓi hey woyse ŋ tiikiŋ ɗe ne, ɓa ɓoƴsohaat pesohaaɗ, ɓa ɗaasu bakaaɗ ciŋ ɓa. ”
E ɗu seedeeciŋ in ceem.
Ŋ hey ɗu woosohe ini Baabiŋ ngo gapoh, kon tasaat ŋ Yerusalem paaɗ po ɗu ɓeku hatili pulohan ŋ ɗafki. »
Yeesu cootiɗ ŋ eel ci
Ŋ finho ineem, Yeesu pulla na ɓa, ɓa yurahha kur ka na woyse Betani. Ŋ ndaam a meeɓpa yaah ciŋ ɗe, a barke'iɗta ɓa.
Wi a na barke'ɗee ɓa, a saɓsukoheeɗa na ɓa, a rapɗasseeɗa ŋ Eel ci.
Ɓa ƴekiɗta ɗe, ƴutta, ɓa dokukka Yerusalem sumoh na sumoh.
Ŋ neeh caam, ɓa gijisɗi Kahan Kooh, ɓa taalndiɗta, ɓa yakɗeeɗa Kooh.
